composition_summary: Drafted one unapproved pure-logic class22 component pc-transfer-06. It distinguishes missing from explicit null via a key-presence guard before reading the value, accepts exact integer 2..11 only, and returns {kind,offset} in every branch. No execution, submission, Q1/Q2 or activation occurred; target typed inputs needs selected-runner support.

payload.name: pc-transfer-06
payload.description: Classify raw offset: missing -> {kind:"missing",offset:null}; explicit null -> {kind:"null",offset:null}; exact integer 2..11 -> {kind:"integer",offset:original}; other -> {kind:"invalid",offset:null}. No bool/float/coercion/defaults/exceptions. Uses a helper invoked at module scope; assigns its returned object to result. Unapproved target typed-inputs draft; selected-runner support, Q1 and human Q2 required.
